title: About
text:
About
    About the MIT team
    A small international team formed for a group introduction project, built as a website with Quarto.
  



  
    
      Our story
      How we came together
      We met in class and quickly found out that each of us came from a different country:
        Myanmar, Indonesia and Taiwan. We decided to turn that into our strength.
      
    
    
      Project details
      
        TeamMIT Team
        Members3
        CountriesMyanmar, Indonesia, Taiwan
        CourseCourse name
        Built withQuarto
      
    
  



  
    
      How we work
      Our values
      The principles that guide how we work together.
    
    
      01CollaborationWe share the work fairly, support each other, and make decisions together.
      02Different perspectivesComing from three countries helps us see problems from more than one angle.
      03Continuous learningEvery project is a chance to learn new tools and improve our skills.

      About
      Mei-Lin leads the research side of the project. She finds reliable sources, summarises the key findings, and writes much of the team's written content. She is curious, thorough, and always asks the questions that make our work stronger.

      Role in the team
      
        Searches and reviews academic sources
        Summarises findings for the team
        Writes and edits the written report
        Checks facts and references
      

      Skills
      
        Literature reviewAcademic sources
        Academic writingReports, essays
        Survey designQuestionnaires
        Critical thinkingAnalysis
      

      In their words
      “Every good answer starts with a better question.”

      About
      Anna leads the MIT team's planning and coordination. She sets milestones, keeps everyone aligned, and makes sure the final work is clear and well presented. Her background is in data analysis, and she enjoys finding the story behind the numbers.

      Role in the team
      
        Plans the project timeline and weekly goals
        Coordinates meetings and task assignments
        Leads the data analysis and reporting
        Reviews the final work before submission
      

      Skills
      
        Data analysisR, Excel
        Project planningTimelines, milestones
        QuartoReports and websites
        PresentationPublic speaking
      

      In their words
      “Good teamwork starts with clear goals and honest communication.”
